svg.title: Three-layer architecture
svg.desc: Layer 3, Legion Go hardware compatibility: InputPlumber touchpad builds, touchpad hand-over, Decky power and controller plugins. Layer 2, portable enhancements: Steam keyboard, input profiles, power policy and CPU boost, microphone, Decky Loader. Layer 1, official Valve SteamOS: SteamOS, Steam client and keyboard, Steam Input, KDE Plasma, Gaming Mode, never replaced.

g.font-family: Noto Sans, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
